seoTitle: Wednesday Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Wednesday test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Wednesday, Enid, Xavier, Bianca, Weems, Eugene, Tyler or Morticia. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who investigates alone and trusts nobody, the one who brings colour to every room, or the one quietly ruling the school? Answer 12 everyday questions and find out which Wednesday character you are.

characters.name: Wednesday Addams
characters.title: The Deadpan Detective
characters.summary: Brilliant, blunt and allergic to fun. You trust your own mind above everyone else's, and you always get to the truth.
description: Like Wednesday, you don't do small talk, colour or feelings, at least not in public. She arrived at Nevermore Academy after an incident involving piranhas and her brother's bullies.
You can't leave a mystery alone. Wednesday has psychic visions, and she investigates every one of them herself, whoever tells her to stop.
You're more loyal than you'd ever admit. Under the deadpan, Wednesday would risk anything for the few people she's decided to keep.
characters.flaw: You push people away, then act surprised when you're alone.
characters.signature: A black dress, a cello, a typewriter and a stare that could stop a clock.
characters.clashReason: they'd find everything you enjoy deeply pointless

characters.name: Enid Sinclair
characters.title: The Ray of Sunshine
characters.summary: Bright, bubbly and endlessly loyal. You bring the colour, the fun and the hugs, whether people want them or not.
description: Like Enid, you're a burst of colour in a dark room. She's Wednesday's roommate at Nevermore, and her half of the room is covered in rainbows.
You've felt like you don't fit in. Enid is a werewolf who couldn't transform when others her age could, and that made her feel like an outsider in her own family.
But you're the best friend anyone could ask for. Enid keeps showing up for Wednesday, even when Wednesday makes it very difficult.
characters.flaw: You wear your heart so openly that it gets hurt a lot.
characters.signature: Rainbow everything, a bag of snacks and a hug nobody asked for.

characters.name: Xavier Thorpe
characters.title: The Brooding Artist
characters.summary: Creative, intense and a little mysterious. You feel everything deeply and pour it into your art.
description: Like Xavier, you're an artist. He's a psychic student at Nevermore whose art can actually come to life.
You keep a lot to yourself. Xavier spends hours in his secret studio, painting what he sees in his dreams.
Being someone's kid isn't always easy. Xavier's father is a famous psychic, and their relationship has always been strained.
characters.flaw: You go quiet and moody instead of saying what's wrong.
characters.signature: Paint on his hands, a sketchbook full of secrets and a hopeful look in Wednesday's direction.
characters.clashReason: they'd go quiet and moody instead of talking it out

characters.name: Bianca Barclay
characters.title: The Queen Bee
characters.summary: Confident, polished and fiercely competitive. You rule the room, but you've fought hard to be free.
description: Like Bianca, you're used to being on top. She's a siren and Nevermore's queen bee, used to getting what she wants.
You don't like losing, to anyone. Bianca's rivalry with Wednesday started the day they met, especially on the fencing strip.
Your confidence hides a hard past. Bianca's mother used her own siren song to run a cult, and Bianca fought to break free of it.
characters.flaw: You'd rather be admired than admit you need anyone.
characters.signature: A perfect uniform, a fencing sword and a voice people can't ignore.

characters.name: Principal Weems
characters.title: The Principal
characters.summary: Commanding, polished and fiercely protective of your institution. You keep the peace, and you keep a lot of secrets.
description: Like Principal Larissa Weems, you're in charge, and you look the part. She runs Nevermore Academy with elegance and a firm hand.
You care about reputation. Weems works hard to protect the school and its students from the outside world, and sometimes that means hiding things.
You have history. Weems is a shapeshifter who was once Morticia Addams's roommate at Nevermore, and their friendly rivalry never quite ended.
characters.flaw: You'd rather keep a secret than let anything damage what you've built.
characters.signature: A tall silhouette, an immaculate outfit and a tight smile that means you're in trouble.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you follow every rule

characters.name: Eugene Ottinger
characters.title: The Loyal Sidekick
characters.summary: Sweet, nerdy and braver than he looks. You're a loyal friend and completely yourself.
description: Like Eugene, you've got a passion and you're not shy about it. He's a sweet, nerdy Nevermore outcast who is devoted to his bees.
You're a loyal friend. Eugene was one of the first people at Nevermore to accept Wednesday exactly as she is.
You're braver than people expect. When Wednesday needed help investigating, Eugene volunteered, even though it put him in real danger.
characters.flaw: You're so eager to help that you walk straight into danger.
characters.signature: A beekeeper's hat, a jar of honey and total faith in his friends.
characters.clashReason: they'd tag along to everything, even when you wanted to go alone

characters.name: Tyler Galpin
characters.title: The Nice Guy With a Secret
characters.summary: Friendly, charming and easy to trust. Maybe a little too easy.
description: Like Tyler, you come across as the nice one. He's the sheriff's son, working at the local café and flirting with Wednesday over coffee.
Everyone likes you. Tyler is the boy-next-door type who seems like the one normal, safe person in Jericho.
But you're hiding who you really are. Tyler turned out to be the Hyde, the monster behind the killings, and he fooled almost everyone.
characters.flaw: Your nice-guy act hides a much darker side.
characters.signature: A café apron, a friendly smile and a very big secret.
characters.clashReason: they'd seem lovely, right up until they weren't

characters.name: Morticia Addams
characters.title: The Elegant Matriarch
characters.summary: Graceful, loving and effortlessly composed. You love your family deeply and you always keep your cool.
description: Like Morticia, you're elegance itself. Wednesday's mother glides through every scene in black, perfectly calm.
You love your family completely, even when they push you away. Morticia and Wednesday clash constantly, but she never stops trying to reach her daughter.
You have a sixth sense too. Morticia is a psychic, and her visions tend to be lighter than Wednesday's.
characters.flaw: You can't stop yourself from trying to fix the people you love.
characters.signature: A long black gown, a single rose and a serene smile.
characters.clashReason: they'd try to understand you when you just want to be left alone

questions.text: Your new roommate covers the whole room in rainbow decorations. You...

options.text: Put tape down the middle. Your side stays black
You're the roommate who did it, and you're proud
Ask to switch rooms. You have standards
Love it. It's so cheerful!

questions.text: Someone you used to compete with at school turns up again years later. You...

options.text: Smile politely. You're both adults now, mostly
Greet them warmly. The past is the past
Challenge them to a rematch
Avoid them. Some history is best left alone

questions.text: A friend is being picked on. You...

options.text: Plan a creative, slightly terrifying revenge
Hug them and tell them the bullies are losers
Report it properly, then deal with the bullies firmly
Be the one they can talk to. Everyone trusts you
Write a dark novel on an old typewriter
Paint for hours in a place nobody knows about
Look after your bees. Better company than most people
Pick up an extra shift at the café. Everyone knows you there

questions.text: You're told to stay out of something that clearly isn't right. You...

options.text: Investigate twice as hard
Follow the rules, but keep a close eye on it yourself
Beg your friend not to get involved, then help them anyway
Let someone else take the risk
Pour it all into your art
Cry, eat ice cream and tell all your friends
Act like you never cared at all
Stay kind to them. They didn't mean to hurt you

questions.text: You decide to learn an instrument. You choose...

options.text: The cello. Played loudly, alone, at night
Singing. People can't ignore your voice
The piano. Elegant, dramatic and a little haunting
Something upbeat you can sing along to with friends

questions.text: A parent wants you to become just like them. You...

options.text: Absolutely not. You're your own person
Break away from them, whatever it costs
Resent it quietly. You're tired of living in their shadow
Hide the parts of yourself they wouldn't understand

questions.text: You're helping to run a big fundraising dinner. You...

options.text: Plan every elegant detail yourself
Work the room. The donors adore you
Help serve the food. You're good with people
Offer to help in the kitchen, as far from the crowd as possible

questions.text: You wake up from a strange, vivid dream that feels important. You...

options.text: Sketch it before it fades
Take it as a sign. Dreams usually mean something
Write it down and start investigating what it means
Text your best friend about it immediately

questions.text: You're a student at a boarding school for outcasts. Something is killing people in the nearby woods, and the principal orders everyone to stay inside. You...

options.text: Go and hunt it down. Alone
Hide in your room, then go and help your best friend anyway
Stay inside. You've got enough problems of your own
Set up a secret stakeout in the woods to help

questions.text: You're the head of a school for outcasts. A difficult new student keeps breaking the rules, but seems to be onto something important. You...

options.text: Make a deal: they can keep going if they report everything to you
Trust them. They remind you of yourself at that age
Give them a chance. Everyone deserves one
Get to know them first. Win their trust, then decide
